subject.title: skill_workshop apply times out ("Approval timed out") on large proposals (~28KB)

question: Should the canonical fix for this issue be the broader lifecycle-approval contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498, or a narrower timeout-only change from one of the older open PRs?
rationale: The code and issue comments prove the bug, but the available fixes choose different approval timeout/security semantics, so automation should not choose the long-term approval contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Land the broad lifecycle fix
options.body: Use the maintainer-authored PR to bound approval waits inside the Codex watchdog, enrich approval prompts, and return actionable pending-state guidance on timeout.

options.title: Land a timeout-only fix
options.body: Adopt the narrower timeout change and leave popup metadata plus timeout-result wording to separate follow-up work.

options.title: Keep policy unchanged
options.body: Continue relying on CLI or `approvalPolicy: auto` workarounds, preserving today's approval behavior and timeout friction.

recommendation.title: Land the broad lifecycle fix
recommendation.body: Use the maintainer-authored PR to bound approval waits inside the Codex watchdog, enrich approval prompts, and return actionable pending-state guidance on timeout.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the issue and authored the current broad closing PR.
